args.summary: Average bill length (mm) for Adelie penguins by island (24 Adelie rows used): Biscoe 38.58, Dream 39.49, Torgersen 38.76 (38.7556). Data issues found and fixed: the island column had two misspelled labels — 'Bisco' (row 12) and 'Torgerson' (row 38) — which I merged into the allowed labels 'Biscoe' and 'Torgersen' via normalize_labels (approved), since the rules file allows only Biscoe/Dream/Torgersen and these rows are otherwise valid. Checks on the columns the question uses came back clean: species has no label variants, bill_length_mm has no out-of-range values (all within the 30–60 rule) and no missing values, and there are no duplicate rows. Columns not used by the question (e.g. body_mass_g stored as text with a comma, one 4,000,000 g outlier, and sex case variants MALE/FEMALE) were left untouched per instructions. Caveat: the two merged island rows are included in the averages under their corrected island names.
